title: FZJ80 Diesel Land Cruiser 4BT Conversion by Duiser
transmission: Rebuilt NV4500 5-speed manual with short-throw shifter kit
ai_summary: A completed, driven 1993 FZJ80 running a rebuilt Cummins 4BT paired to a rebuilt NV4500 and a rebuilt part-time transfer case, listed for sale with stock electric lockers, a 3-inch lift, and 35s. Listing includes new lift pump, injectors, radiator, alternator, and A/C components; a commenter suggested the engine was still tuned near-stock and could be improved with fuel pin/screw adjustments.
